caveat: CSS measured describes the documentation site, not the Liquid Glass material; material principles come from page text.

taste.name: Cor contida para o conteúdo atravessar o controle
taste.trigger: When the designers faced controls and navigation that sit over changing content and must stay legible without dyeing it
taste.decision: Chose a neutral control layer with colour left to the content over brand-coloured toolbars and buttons
taste.reason: Because a tinted control blocks what is behind it, while a neutral one lets the content infuse the material and shine through, which is what makes the surface read as glass
evidence: page text: allow your content to infuse them and shine through
accent blue #0066CC/#0071E3 on 0% of the area

taste.name: Hierarquia por foco de conteúdo, não por ornamento
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a new material that could be applied to every surface at once
taste.decision: Chose to define layout and navigation so the most important content is in focus over spreading the effect evenly across all elements
taste.reason: Because material on everything removes the contrast that tells the eye what is primary; hierarchy needs a few elements that float and the rest that stay quiet
evidence: page text: establish hierarchy, create harmony, and maintain consistency
three strong type levels (40/19/17px) and 12px for 89 nodes

taste.name: Controles padrão herdam o material; só o personalizado o reimplementa
taste.trigger: When the designers faced thousands of existing apps that would have to be redrawn
taste.decision: Chose to make standard controls pick up the appearance and behaviour automatically, with custom effects as the exception, over asking every team to restyle each element
taste.reason: Because consistency across devices depends on one source of the material, and a bespoke glass per app breaks the shared language
evidence: page text: standard components pick up the appearance and behavior of this material automatically
page text: adopting Liquid Glass doesn't mean reinventing your app from the ground up

taste.name: Restraint: dois raios e nenhuma sombra no documento que explica o vidro
taste.trigger: When the designers faced the page that sells a luminous, fluid material and the pull to demonstrate it with glows and blurs
taste.decision: Chose a flat page with two radii (6px and 18px), no shadows and one link blue over a demonstration made of effects
taste.reason: Because the material is shown in the before/after images; the surrounding page must not compete with it
evidence: transitions limited to colour (0.32s, 0.5s) and width
